summary: QR/Barcode-based AI chat system for vehicle owner contact. Users scan QR stickers on parked vehicles to open masked chat interface. System supports cars/bikes with encrypted privacy layer, Hindi AI responses, and secure vehicle-owner mapping. Owner registration via OTP required, with monetization through QR sticker sales (₹299-₹499).
architectural_notes: QR code generation and scanning system
Phone number masking/privacy layer for all communications
Admin dashboard for monitoring and management
QR and barcode scanning capabilities for vehicle identification
Weather-proof physical sticker design with unique vehicle IDs
Secure database for encrypted vehicle-owner data mapping
End-to-end encryption for all chat communications
OTP-based owner registration and verification system
